## DnaSource type

The source of the DNA to be installed, either as binary data, or from a path

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type DnaSource = {
    type: "path";
    value: string;
} | {
    type: "bundle";
    value: DnaBundle;
} | {
    type: "hash";
    value: DnaHash;
};
```
